decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed mezzanine floor and external alterations will not have an adverse upon the servicing of the industrial unit or its appearance. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing of Development) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of a mezzanine floor to create storage, shower room and office space to 1st floor of building.
